DZA.note: El Mohammedia is in service but the document does not say it rents to outside organisations.

facts.fact: Minister Meriem Benmouloud said a cloud is being made available to ministries and state bodies, notably those without a data centre, and urged national bodies to host their digital activity in Algeria to uphold digital sovereignty.

The High Commission for Digitalisation said real data of ministries and public bodies began to be inserted into the national database, made possible by the national El Mohammedia data centre being in service.
facts.system: national database / El Mohammedia data centre

facts.fact: Minister Benmouloud announced the national digital services platform 'Dzair Services', grouping existing service platforms in one space, would launch soon, with final touches being made.

DZA.note: The document names a national interoperability system being commissioned but states no law or decree.

facts.fact: Insertion of real data of ministries and public bodies into the national database began, made possible by the national El Mohammedia data centre being in service, per Minister Benmouloud.

DZA.note: Startups minister is present only as an attendee; no startup law or fund stated.
